description: This source file defines API routes related to user authentication, registration, MFA setup, token refresh, and login using FastAPI framework. It includes route handlers that interact with database models and security functions to manage user sessions and security features.

classes.name: APIRouter

methods.name: login(req: LoginRequest, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Handles user authentication, supports MFA, generates JWT tokens, and logs the login event.

methods.name: refresh_token(refresh_token: str, session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Allows clients to exchange a refresh token for a new access token, validating the refresh token.

methods.name: mfa_setup(session: AsyncSession = Depends(get_session), request: Request = None, refresh_token: str | None = None)
methods.description: Generates or retrieves an MFA secret for a user, facilitating MFA setup via TOTP.
